notes: Asking for a shape in words now works as well as asking for it in numbers. Typing "9:16" always planned a reframe, but "square it", "go vertical", "vertical please" and "tiktok it" came back with "I did not catch an edit in that" — for the very same four shapes Crisp already makes. Twenty-three phrasings that should have worked were dead. They work now, and naming your footage still does what you asked: "upscale my vertical video" upscales it, it does not reframe it.
